title: festuca geniculata
intro: Festuca geniculata, commonly known as bent grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving digestion, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Festuca geniculata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant.
